programme.desc: After clinching his 150th hard-court win, the Australian Open champion Carlos Alcaraz now eyes his 151st in a Qatar Open clash with Frenchman Valentin Royer. (18.02)

programme.title: Live: ATP/WTA Tennis
programme.desc: As world number one Carlos Alcaraz prepares to face Karen Khachanov in Qatar, Dubai sees Amanda Anisimova play Mirra Andreeva before Coco Gauff battles Alex Eala. Jessica Pegula features.

programme.title: ATP Finals: Turin Final
programme.desc: World number one Carlos Alcaraz faces Italy's reigning ATP Finals champion Jannik Sinner in their sixth meeting of the year, marking the finale to the 2025 Tour season in Turin. (16.11)

programme.title: WTA Final: Doha
programme.desc: Jelena Ostapenko's near seven-year wait to vie for a WTA 1000 title ends in Doha, as the former Grand Slam champion faces 23-year-old American Amanda Anisimova in an unseeded final. (15.02)

programme.title: Live: ATP/WTA Tennis
programme.desc: As world number one Carlos Alcaraz prepares to face Karen Khachanov in Qatar, Dubai sees Amanda Anisimova play Mirra Andreeva before Coco Gauff battles Alex Eala. Jessica Pegula features.

programme.title: Live: ATP Tennis
programme.desc: Jannik Sinner's debut Qatar run continues against Jakub Mensik as American trio Taylor Fritz, Tommy Paul and Frances Tiafoe all feature in Delray Beach. Rio's own Joao Fonseca competes.

programme.title: ATP Final: Dallas
programme.desc: Taylor Fritz and Ben Shelton - the Dallas top two - vie for the crown. Fritz downed Marin Cilic in the semi-finals, while Shelton dethroned reigning champion Denis Shapovalov. (15.02)

programme.title: ATP Finals: Turin Final
programme.desc: World number one Carlos Alcaraz faces Italy's reigning ATP Finals champion Jannik Sinner in their sixth meeting of the year, marking the finale to the 2025 Tour season in Turin. (16.11)

programme.title: WTA Final: Dubai
programme.desc: A women's singles champion is crowned in Dubai. Mirra Andreeva - the youngest-ever WTA finalist - and Denmark's Clara Tauson face off for glory. (22.02)

programme.title: ATP Final: Geneva
programme.desc: In what was a chance for Novak Djokovic to join Jimmy Connors and Roger Federer in winning a 100th tour-level title, the 38-year-old Serb battled Hubert Hurkacz in the Geneva Open final.

programme.title: WTA Final: Indian Wells
programme.desc: Mirra Andreeva meets top seed Aryna Sabalenka in the Indian Wells final. Sabalenka avenged her Australian Open defeat to Keys in the semis, while Andreeva dethroned Swiatek. (16.03)

programme.title: ATP Final: Buenos Aires
programme.desc: One win away from his first title on home soil, Argentine Francisco Cerundolo competes for the Buenos Aires title against second seed Luciano Darderi of Italy. (15.02)

programme.title: Tennis Highlights
